narrative.overview: An art-directed technical publication: atmospheric imagery introduces a clear professional narrative. Swiss typography supplies structure; architecture and abstract images supply emotion. The system is restrained, intelligent, and exploratory, not a lifestyle magazine.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use one restrained interface accent; image palettes may be richer without becoming additional UI token families.

rules.name: The Type Authority Rule
rules.body: Use grotesk type for authority, mono for metadata, and serif for reflection.

rules.name: The Fit Rule
rules.body: Fix intrinsic grid sizing and allow code blocks to scroll internally; never hide page overflow to disguise a layout defect.

dos: Do connect images to professional substance.
Do keep AI imagery and unknown facts explicitly labeled.
Do preserve logical reading order at every width.
Do use actual production components for technical evidence.
donts: Don't introduce fake physicality or decorative card shadows.
Don't clip horizontal overflow to conceal broken layout.
Don't turn this into a lifestyle magazine or invent commercial claims.
